name: role-release
description: Closes the effort segment of the role an agent currently holds, by running role-assume's release command, so that effort after this point is not attributed to that role.
inputs: The agent name and, when the agent was given one, the session id, matching what was passed to role-assume.
outputs: The closed segment as JSON, or a flagged warning when no segment was open (effort outside a segment is recorded as unassigned).

logging.note: No logic file of its own; the release command logs through role-assume.

runtime-independent-rationale: role-release is an instruction set an agent follows in the moment; the logic that closes the segment is role-assume's main.py.
